we have shown that the seasonal-trend decomposition of the time series based on loess (STL), is a powerful tool for the analysis of time-series data in remote sensing.

we developed an automatic procedure to identify the best decomposition of time series, and applied this procedure to MERIS data for the Sagres region, SW Iberian peninsula, and identified the temporal variability in the dynamical features for water leaving reflectances and phytoplankton pigment index.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the seasonal component of the API 1 is a good indicator of phytoplankon variability in time and space, and can be used to identify the phytoplankton seasonal dynamics in coastal areas.
the STL is a robust and flexible tool for analyzing time series data and it has the potential to be applied to other time series of oceanographic data.
the seasonal-trend decomposition is a useful technique for the analysis of time series of MERIS products.
